'''Renci Tosh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and recruiting agent during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==

At one point, her [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] suffered mechanical problems, and she was forced to crash-land on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], not far from [[Great Rock]]. Tosh was captured on her way into town by thugs in the employ of a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], and imprisoned. She managed to escape, but her [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was hauled away by a group of raiders looking to make a profit by selling it off for scrap.<ref name="CG1" />

Tosh enlisted the aid of some local [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to help her escape the thugs looking for her, and return her to her ship. Prior to recovering her stolen ship, Renci and the others dealt with a [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]] (assisted by a local [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] savrip-hunter, [[Teerik]]) and a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Gida Luroon]], before finally facing [[Yarroq]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] leader of the raiders who had made off with her starfighter to begin with.<ref name="CG1" />
